title: Mountain bike sabotage after Senate briefing

tellings.quote: About 3 weeks later, someone sawed through the bolt that holds my mountain bike seat on

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who has long pushed for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, says that in 2023 he gave a briefing to people at the US Senate. About three weeks later, he says, someone sawed through the bolt that holds the seat on his mountain bike. He tells it as a sign that someone wanted to hurt or frighten him for speaking out.
